title: "Olympic"
output: html_document

```{r}
library(readr)
library(mosaic)
library(tidyverse)
library(pander)
Olympics <- read_csv("Data/Olympics.csv")
View(Olympics)
```

Have male gymnasts who compete in the summer olympics gotten shorter over the years

```{r}
NewData <- Olympics %>% 
  group_by(ID, Name, Sex, Year, Season, Sport) %>% 
  summarise(Ave_Ht = mean(Height),
            Ave_Wt = mean(Weight))
View(NewData)
```

```{r}
Summer <- filter(NewData, Season %in% "Summer" & Sex %in% "M" & Sport %in% "Gymnastics")
View(Summer)
```

```{r}
boxplot(Ave_Ht ~ Year, data=Summer)
```
